checks.claim: Complete record/control order agrees with stock PATH and main reader
checks.evidence: lblrtm.f90:674/1175/1186,4640 onward; 278 records, 45 bottom-first layers, IFORM=1/IXSECT=1, explicit angle 0, CMRG=1, IOD=0, DVOUT=0, SECNT0=1 and SECNTK=0.

checks.claim: Explicit layer-average pressure, temperature and amounts are used
checks.evidence: PATH retains PAVE/TAVE as PAVEL/TAVEL; OPPATH uses WKL/WBROADL/XAMNT directly. No atmosphere interpolation/physical-height reconstruction is claimed.

checks.claim: Ordinary and external molecule read grouping is correct
checks.evidence: 22 ordinary slots, first seven + broadener then 15 remaining slots; external XS reader reads seven XAMNT slots + WBROADX unconditionally. Four cross-section names plus three zero placeholders therefore correctly place broadener in field 8. FSCDXS maps the four names; selected data coverage limitations retained.

checks.claim: Nominal heights do not drive this restricted LTE OD calculation
checks.evidence: ALTAV computed as finite nominal metadata; OPDPTH calls NONLTE only IHIRAC=4, while this deck uses IHIRAC=1/IEMIT=0/IAERSL=0/ISOTPL=0. This conclusion excludes NLTE, aerosol, geometry-dependent radiation and other controls.
ICNTNM=0 clears continuum/CIA switches and OPDPTH:6216-6228 skips CONTNM. No MT_CKD data-reader requirement on that path; no equivalence to RRTMGP continuum asserted.

checks.claim: GNUdbl reader explicitly accepts single-precision LNFL record representation
checks.evidence: struct_types INPUT_HEADER has REAL(8) VMIN/VMAX and INTEGER(4) NREC/NWDS; INPUT_BLOCK stores line positions REAL(8), remaining numeric fields REAL(4)/INTEGER(4). RDLIN uses npnlhd=6 and BUFIN_sgl for NWDS, whose utility uses explicit INTEGER*4/REAL*4, then converts into working-precision LINE_DATA. Thus default INTEGER/REAL 8 does not reinterpret every TAPE3 word as 8 bytes. Actual first-reader acceptance remains runtime evidence.

output_contract.reason: oprop.f90:396-404 actual IOD=0/IMRG=1 branch uses PTHODD initialized ODdeflt_; preceding comment incorrectly mentions PTHODI/ODint. Per-layer adaptive DV; do not presume a common spectral grid.
output_contract.other_files: TAPE6 and stock TAPE9/TAPE10/TAPE11/TAPE12 work files may be opened; do not treat incidental existence as a valid spectrum.

runtime_inputs.additional_runtime_requirement: Preserve pinned stock GNUdbl executable and its complete linked-library closure, including non-system NetCDF paths. Restricted controls do not request TAPE4, REJ, aerosol, emission or continuum files.

limits: Static readiness is not actual full-deck reader acceptance or successful optical-depth output. First stock invocation must record actual RC and validate outputs/log diagnostics.
Deck decimal formatting quantizes captured inputs; E15.7/F10.4 READ field widths do not inherently mandate those print precisions. No original-state binary64 identity is claimed for serialized cards.
Native32 plus 13 extension is a held-state diagnostic carrier, not new WRF state; nominal heights are bookkeeping only.
ICNTNM=0, cross-section interpolation/extrapolation and this molecular/database choice are independent-reference policies, not optical accuracy or RRTMGP parity.
